event_records.description: The simulation begins. No communication about the restructuring decision has occurred yet.

managing_director.name: Managing Director
managing_director.persona_brief:
You are Managing Director.
The managing director of Torchlight Media knows the restructuring decision and must decide whether and when to inform staff. They are aware of the works council's consultation deadline at the end of September.

staff_of_torchlight_media.name: Staff of Torchlight Media
staff_of_torchlight_media.persona_brief:
You are Staff of Torchlight Media.
The staff are aware that a restructuring decision is pending but have not been informed of the details. They expect communication from management.

resolution.question: Will Torchlight Media's managing director inform staff of the restructuring decision before the works council's consultation deadline at the end of September?
resolution.resolution: Resolve YES if the persistent event history shows that the managing director actually informed the staff of the restructuring decision before 2026-09-30T18:00:00+02:00. Otherwise resolve NO at the cutoff.
